title: Share a Theme with Provide and Inject
short_description: Practice providing a reactive ref from an ancestor and injecting it into a descendant.
description: App.vue controls the theme and ThemeStatus.vue must consume it without receiving props.
When the provider changes the theme, the descendant must update automatically.
instructions: In App.vue, provide theme using the theme key.
In ThemeStatus.vue, inject theme using light as the fallback.
Keep the ref intact to preserve the reactive connection.

hints.title: Provider
hints.body: Use `provide("theme", theme)` after creating the ref

hints.title: Descendant
hints.body: The second `inject` argument defines the fallback value.
